The names of the department offices on the fourth floor of the Main Building are displayed on the floor directory.
A shared printing station available to students is on the fourth floor of the Main Building.
The research labs on the fifth floor of the Main Building are not spaces open to the general public.
The collaborative research lab on the sixth floor of the Main Building is used by authorized research members.
Consultations with the research support office on the seventh floor of the Main Building follow the posted appointment process.
Visitors to staff offices on the eighth floor of the Main Building expect the staff member with whom they have an appointment to be in the office at the scheduled time.
Public administrative services on the ninth floor of the Main Building are provided during each department's operating hours.
The elevators in the Main Building connect the underground parking level through the tenth floor.
The floor directory agent can describe the floors and space names of published facilities.
The floor directory agent cannot check the current occupancy status of meeting rooms.
First-time visitors are more familiar with department names than floor numbers and can more easily understand directions centered on department names.
On public holidays, some administrative offices may not operate even when the Main Building is open.
The floor directory agent cannot verify in real time, at the time of an inquiry, whether published floor-by-floor information matches the actual layout.
Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, the underground parking garage cannot be used for general parking.
Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, the pedestrian entrance door to the underground parking garage is kept locked.
Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, instruct staff to use a physical access card to pass through the locked pedestrian entrance door to the underground parking garage.
Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Instruct construction/facilities personnel to access the underground parking garage through the controlled on-site access procedure that has been approved.
Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: The stairs from the Main Building down to the underground parking garage are closed to all users.
Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: The underground parking garage is used as a temporary storage area for construction materials.
Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: After the clear-out, personal items left in the underground parking garage were moved to the lost and found center.
Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Outdoor Parking Lot A connected to the Main Building is closed during the construction period.
Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, Outdoor Parking Lot C operates as a temporary alternative parking lot for vehicles visiting the Main Building.
Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Outdoor Parking Lot A is planned to reopen immediately after construction on the Main Building ends.
Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, the sloped access road connecting Outdoor Parking Lot A and the Main Building underground parking garage is blocked.

Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Based on posted information, the parking guidance agent may explain the closures of the underground parking garage and Outdoor Parking Lot A and the alternative use of Outdoor Parking Lot C during the construction period.

Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, the parking guidance agent may explain the location of Outdoor Parking Lot C but cannot check or guarantee available spaces at the time of an inquiry.

Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: A visitor accustomed to parking at the Main Building may expect to be able to enter the underground parking garage or Outdoor Parking Lot A during the construction period, drive as far as the closed access road, and then search again for Outdoor Parking Lot C.

Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Delivery drivers and external maintenance contractors accustomed to unloading in Outdoor Parking Lot A may approach the same point during the construction period and then reconfirm the delivery time or unloading location at the control line.

analysis.overview: The frames complement one another: the reference provides Main Building wayfinding, facility, service, and verification guidance, while the compared frame supplies temporary construction-period parking and access rules. Their only substantive overlap is a consistent policy of grounding guidance in published facilities information and temporary notices.
